### <a id="choose"></a>choose

(1) **Deprecated:** Use the other form.

First call.

(2) Second call.

**Signatures · 2 overloads**

(1) · Since 1.0.0 · [Source](index.d.ts#L13)

```ts
export function choose(input: Value): Value;
export { choose as again };
```

(2) · [Source](index.d.ts#L15)

```ts
export function choose(input: readonly Value[]): readonly Value[];
export { choose as again };
```

**Parameters**

`input`: `Value` (1), `readonly Value[]` (2)

(1) First input.

(2) Second input.

**Returns**

`Value` (1), `readonly Value[]` (2)

(2) A list.

(1) **Example**

